header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: said this, narrates Hazrat Zaid ibn Arqam (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث حسن باب ماجاء ان المستشار مؤتمن رقم:٢٨٢٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The one who is consulted is one who is trusted” (therefore, if someone is consulted about some matter, the one consulted in that matter must not make public the secret of the one consulting him. He should advise only what will be of most benefit to the one seeking advice).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِذَا حَدَّثَ الرَّجُلُ بِالْحَدِيْثِ ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ فَهِيَ اَمَانَةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في نقل الحديث رقم:٤٨٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “If a person tells another something and then looks around here and there, that matter is one that must be kept safe.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Someone tells you something, and he did not tell you that it must be kept secret. However, if from his manner you realise that this matter of his should not be made public, for example if you notice him looking here and there while speaking, then that matter is an Amanah (trust). You must keep it safe just as you would keep safe an Amanah (something entrusted to you).
(Ma'ariful Hadith)
